profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I’m a senior software engineer with 9+ years of experience designing, shipping and running cloud services at scale. Lately my focus has been taking LLM and multi-agent systems from prototype to production. I've built core parts of a multi-agent service that takes a problem from diagnosis through root cause to an automated fix and I've designed shared infrastructure that lets AI agents share context with each other.

I care just as much about what makes systems trustworthy: reliability, security and clean architecture. I’ve led complex multi-region launches, run incident root-cause analyses and designed security architecture that other teams adopted as their standard.

Earlier in my career, I built software used in thousands of retail locations. That included a computer vision system that cut a core operational process by 30%.

I enjoy writing the spec, owning the hard problems and mentoring the engineers around me as much as writing the code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building the AI agents behind Azure’s customer support experience, from early prototypes to production systems that help customers and support engineers resolve issues faster.

Built core parts of a multi-agent troubleshooting service on AKS that takes a support case through scoping, root-cause analysis, automated fixes, solution recommendations and support request creation. Combined 4 sub-agents under one orchestrator and exposed it to other teams through the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.

Built shared infrastructure that lets AI agents publish what they learn about a case and add that context to new cases, secured with service-to-service auth defined in infrastructure as code.

Led the production rollout of an LLM-powered assistant that helps support engineers prepare their first response to new cases. Ramped it from 5% to 100% of traffic and added multi-turn context so customers aren’t asked the same questions twice.

Led an innovation-week prototype of an LLM classifier for about 4,000 misrouted support cases a month.

Mentored junior engineers and interns.

Skills: AI Agents · LLMs · Semantic Kernel · Azure OpenAI · C# · Python · AKS

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Built and scaled Azure’s live support chat and customer support experiences in the Azure portal, with a focus on reliability, security and reuse across teams.

Development lead for launching live support chat in Azure Government, owning configuration, CDN, infrastructure as code and monitoring. It was one of the team’s most complex projects.

Co-led the team’s security hardening under Microsoft’s Secure Future Initiative. Designed a Front Door/WAF setup for 3 services that was adopted as a reference design across the organization, and added network isolation, DDoS protection and stronger authentication.

Re-architected live chat for zero-downtime, multi-region deployment, and led the root-cause analysis for a high-severity CDN outage.

Built a reusable React chat component, published as an npm package, so partner teams could add support chat to their own products.

Shipped a resource health card in the Azure portal that helped reduce daily support cases.
Built the first version of an LLM-based scoping-question generator and improved it through evaluation rounds until it beat existing solutions and shipped to production.

Promoted in 2024. Acted as de facto team lead and mentored junior engineers.

Skills: C# · .NET · TypeScript · React · Azure Front Door · Infrastructure as Code · Cloud Security

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an innovative solution that uses Computer Vision and Optical Character Recognition (OCR) to reduce time taken to process inventory arriving in stores using Google Vision and Python.

Expanded on Computer Vision work to create a proof of concept of a system to improve on-shelf availability of inventory in stores. Successfully demonstrated working solution that is able to detect inventory in overhead shelf locations using Google Cloud PubSub, Google Cloud Functions, Google Cloud Vision, Google Cloud BigQuery, and Python.

Built mobile friendly, responsive web application used in all 2000+ store locations for managing inbound inventory using Angular, NodeJS, Java (SpringBoot), Jasmine, Cypress, and PostgreSQL.

Collaborated with engineering leads to redesign legacy enterprise inventory management system using cloud native methodologies. Developed and deployed backend applications to facilitate redesign using Java (SpringBoot), Google Cloud Spanner, Google Cloud PubSub, and Kubernetes.

Led team of developers in building web application for tracking productivity of in-store freight team using Java (Quarkus) and Angular. Coordinated with business stakeholders and UX.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed web application that drove sales growth for professional contracting customers using ReactJS, NodeJS, Java (SpringBoot), Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF).

Created REST APIs to manage internal and external gift card purchases and activation.

Secured web applications end-to-end using industry-standard OAuth2 authorization protocol.

Created and maintained CI/CD pipelines in TeamCity and Jenkins.

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Assist students in the introductory computer science courses with understanding concepts, algorithms, code reading and writing, etc. in the Java programming language via weekly office hours of 5 hours per week.

Lead a weekly 30 student lab session in which students expand on their programming skills and are introduced to working with the Linux operating system.

Review and grade homework and lab assignments.

positions.title: Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Support all technology in the emerging technologies lab which includes 3D printing, 3D scanning, device testing, and small electronics construction.

Develop and maintain a Swift desktop application that helps support various processes in the lab.

Work with university students, faculty and staff to help develop their ideas and projects relating to use of the technology lab.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed a live monitoring user feedback tool and integrated it into a dashboard that gathers and displays performance data of a production application

Developed a user friendly data querying tool that allowed for direct measurement of the impact of a production application on the company's associates' and customer's growth

Deployed and maintained both applications on the cloud, using Pivotal Cloud Foundry.

Worked on features of an application that were released into production. 

Practiced Extreme Programming (XP).
